entries.PRT-QL-104: A {business} earned {totalProfit}. Before the remaining profit was shared, {partnerA} received {allowancePercentA}% of gross profit and {partnerB} received {allowancePercentB}% of gross profit. Their equal-period capitals were {capitalA} and {capitalB}. What was {targetPartner}'s final receipt?
entries.PRT-QL-105: A {business} ran for {totalDuration}. {partnerA} kept {capitalA} invested throughout; {partnerB} started with {initialCapitalB} but withdrew {withdrawnCapitalB} after {changeAfterB}; and {partnerC} kept {capitalC} throughout. From total profit {totalProfit}, find {targetPartner}'s share.
